name: OmaDoctor
author: Davedes83
description: Diagnose common Omarchy system problems. Runs read-only health checks across system, network, audio and storage, explains what each finding means, and produces a redacted diagnostic report you can paste into a bug report or support channel.

schema.label: Background scan interval (seconds, 0 disables)
schema.description: A quick scan spawns several short-lived processes. 0 (the default) scans only when the panel is opened.

schema.label: Notify when a check gets worse
schema.description: Fires at most once per worsening transition, never on the first scan, and never after a scan you ran yourself.

schema.label: AI command for 'Ask AI'
schema.description: Full command line; the report is fed on stdin. Leave empty to auto-detect from your PATH. e.g. 'ollama run llama3.2' or 'aichat'.

schema.label: Model, for assistants that require one
schema.description: Used for 'ollama run <model>', which has no default-model mode. Ignored by other assistants.
